settings.title: Sonos connection
settings.hint: The app talks to your speakers directly over the local network — no Sonos account or login is involved. Leave the address empty to let the app find a speaker itself.
settings.pollHint: Sonos does not notify us when an alarm changes, so the app asks at this interval. Longer intervals are gentler on the Homey.
